text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As class representative, I hope to Bakushin my way through my races!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Then, I'll become a role model for everyone by dominating all the G1 races! WOW, what an exemplary idea! My intelligence scares even me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
